## Photos

Top review

“Great job on a roof leak!

Professional, competent, polite, prompt. Very pleased with the service! They came in at EXACTLY the appointed time, showed us the issue, took pictures, fixed it so that...”

Pierre D. [See all](https://www.mapquest.com/us/florida/devlin-roofing-276585920#reviews)

4700 West Prospect Rd, Unit 101, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309

Since 1984, Devlin Roofing has been providing expert roof maintenance services in Fort Lauderdale, FL and surrounding areas. Can't find your roof leak? We specialize in finding and repairing roof leaks, so give us a call today. We offer both residential and commercial roof repair services on tile roofs, flat roofs, shingle roofs and even metal roofs. Serving clients throughout Broward County, we offer free estimates for your convenience. We are dedicated to providing the highest level of service and workmanship to all of our clients and offer a 1 year warranty on workmanship for repairs and a 3 year warranty on waterproofing. Learn More About Devlin Roofing: Residential Roof Repairs - Leak patching, waterproofing and more Commercial Roof Repairs - Roof inspections, rotten wood replacement and more Devlin Roofing Photo Gallery - View some of our work. Contact Devlin Roofing today at 954-492-8252, or browse the website for more information about our products and services. Devlin Roofing offers a variety of professional roof maintenance services and roof accessories for our residential customers in the Fort Lauderdale, FL area. We are proud to provide services to homes, apartments and condominiums, and we are licensed and insured for your protection. Our experienced staff can perform roof inspections from home purchases or for insurance certifications. In addition to our roof repair services, we also offer preventive maintenance, sucg as waterproofing. Waterproofing your roof will extend its life expectancy and will save you time and money - it is a wise investment for your home. Our waterproofing services include roof cleaning, tile fill for cracks, the primer and waterproof coating, as well as roofing paint. With more than 25 years experience, Devlin Roofing of Fort Lauderdale, FL, provides roof repair and maintenance services and roof accessories to commercial clients throughout Broward County. Fax: 954-541-5694
